serviceShortDescription.value: Inpatient and outpatient behavioral health evaluation and treatment for adults and older adults.

serviceDetail.value: Behavioral health services include crisis evaluation, inpatient psychiatry, and geriatric behavioral health units.

serviceShortDescription.value: Screening, medical oncology, and coordinated cancer treatment.

serviceDetail.value: Cancer care includes screening, medical oncology, radiation oncology, and access to clinical trials.

serviceShortDescription.value: Gastroenterology and digestive health services including endoscopy and hospital-based GI care.

serviceDetail.value: Digestive care teams evaluate reflux, liver disease, inflammatory bowel disease, and other GI conditions.

serviceShortDescription.value: Emergency evaluation and treatment for life-threatening illness and injury.

serviceDetail.value: Emergency departments treat serious injuries, stroke, chest pain, and other urgent conditions that cannot wait.

serviceShortDescription.value: Cardiology, vascular, and cardiac catheterization services.

serviceDetail.value: Heart and vascular teams diagnose and treat coronary disease, heart failure, arrhythmia, and vascular conditions.

serviceShortDescription.value: X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and other diagnostic imaging.

serviceDetail.value: Imaging services support diagnosis and treatment planning with X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and mammography where available.

serviceShortDescription.value: Hospital and outpatient laboratory testing that supports diagnosis, treatment, and emergency care.

serviceDetail.value: Laboratory teams process blood work, cultures, and other diagnostic tests.

serviceShortDescription.value: Brain, spine, stroke, and neurology care.

serviceDetail.value: Neuroscience teams treat stroke, brain tumors, spine conditions, and movement disorders.

serviceShortDescription.value: Bone, joint, and sports medicine care for adults and children.

serviceDetail.value: Orthopedic specialists treat fractures, joint replacement, spine conditions, and sports injuries.

serviceShortDescription.value: Specialty and hospital care for infants, children, and adolescents.

serviceDetail.value: Pediatric care covers wellness, complex chronic conditions, surgery, and emergency services designed for children.

serviceShortDescription.value: Walk-in evaluation for non-life-threatening illnesses and injuries.

serviceDetail.value: Urgent care clinics treat sprains, infections, minor injuries, and illnesses that need prompt attention but are not emergencies.

serviceShortDescription.value: Obstetrics, gynecology, breast care, and maternity services.

serviceDetail.value: Women's health programs include prenatal care, labor and delivery, gynecology, and breast health.
